code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    counts={x:sum(r.count(x) for r in g) for x in set(x for r in g for x in r)}
    bg=max(counts,key=counts.get)
    # The L-shaped line is the color key. Recolor the principal compact object to its color.
    cue=max((x for x in counts if x!=bg), key=lambda x: counts[x])
    # In examples the key line's color has the greatest non-background footprint.
    # Select the largest connected component not belonging to the key line.
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for i in range(h):
      for j in range(w):
       if (i,j) in seen or g[i][j] in (bg,cue): continue
       col=g[i][j]; stack=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); cells=[]
       while stack:
        a,b=stack.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
        for x,y in ((a-1,b),(a+1,b),(a,b-1),(a,b+1)):
         if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and (x,y) not in seen and g[x][y]==col:
          seen.add((x,y)); stack.append((x,y))
       comps.append(cells)
    # recolor component closest to cue-line cells, favor compact multicell objects
    keycells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==cue]
    if comps:
      target=max(comps,key=lambda c:(len(c),-min(min(abs(a-x)+abs(b-y) for x,y in keycells) for a,b in c)))
      for a,b in target:g[a][b]=cue
    return g
'''; p.write_text(code)

code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # recolor the short straight marker nearest the distinctive bent line
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=max(set(x for r in g for x in r),key=lambda x:sum(r.count(x) for r in g))
    cue=next((g[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and sum(g[i][j]==g[r][c] for i in range(h) for j in range(w))>=5),None)
    if cue is None:return g
    # choose the nearest compact straight pair to the cue
    comps=[]; seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
       col=g[r][c]
       if col in (bg,cue) or (r,c) in seen: continue
       todo=[(r,c)];seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
       while todo:
        a,b=todo.pop();cells.append((a,b))
        for x,y in ((a-1,b),(a+1,b),(a,b-1),(a,b+1)):
         if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and (x,y) not in seen and g[x][y]==col:seen.add((x,y));todo.append((x,y))
       if len(cells)>=2: comps.append(cells)
    key=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==cue]
    cand=[x for x in comps if len(set(r for r,c in x))==1 or len(set(c for r,c in x))==1]
    if cand:
      t=min(cand,key=lambda x:min(abs(r-a)+abs(c-b) for r,c in x for a,b in key))
      for r,c in t:g[r][c]=cue
    return g
'''; p.write_text(code)
